scope: Reported cohort only; excerpt of the retrospective source protocol.
design: Retrospective fixed-cohort reanalysis of real existing predictions; no new inference and no model-output-based selection.

cohort.P: All 525 requests in the original benchmark-positive plus expansion definition
cohort.A: 525 sampled without replacement from original 1402 A

sampling.allocation: Hamilton largest remainder proportional to the original A pool's stratum sizes
sampling.within_stratum: ascending SHA256(JSON([seed, request_id])); no seed search

statistics.primary: Equal request-weighted SafeEX and Full, evidence lower/upper separately
statistics.paired: Same request IDs for all four methods
statistics.sensitivity: 1000 deterministic A resamples with P fixed; retrospective sampling sensitivity, no new inference
statistics.uncertainty: 2000 paired cluster bootstrap replicates by original dataset/database/question ID, same cluster weight across methods and A/P; renormalize A/P to 50/50 per draw; finite-cohort descriptive interval

limitations: P composition differs from A in question/dataset/role mix; rebalancing does not isolate a causal P-share effect
Historical API calls were made at different dates; results are reused, not a simultaneous rerun
Effective policy variants/levels of one original question are clustered, not independent questions
